data.name: SEED
data.detailed_description:
START A WORLD

SEED is a persistent, player-driven MMO that simulates humanity in a world that never sleeps.

Welcome to Avesta, a planet where humanity has a second chance to define its future. Every character, known as a Seedling, is a bio-engineered human who works, sleeps, and socializes based on their own schedule. Seedlings coexist autonomously in the same shared, persistent world, working together and forming lasting connections, even while you’re offline.

Built by former EVE Online developers, the planet of Avesta is truly persistent, evolving over time based on the decisions of the Seedlings and you, their beloved Cultivators.

THE STAKES ARE REAL

In SEED, survival is a collaborative effort: if you don’t produce food, others don't eat; if others don't build shelter, you have nowhere to stay. Because the simulation runs around the clock, the stakes are high; failure to maintain your community’s production could mean the permanent death of your Seedlings.

DEEP INTERACTION

SEED leverages Perspective, a system that allows Seedlings to think, feel and from true emergent relationships with each other and, you, the Cultivator. Talk directly to your characters via the Seedling Chat, with every conversation having a lasting impact on the development of your Seedlings and the surrounding society.

PLAYER-DRIVEN EVERYTHING

From the smallest chair to the most complex machinery, every item in Avesta is gathered, crafted and sold by players in a completely player-driven economy. As your camp grows into a city, you must navigate the challenges of collaborative governance. Form shared societies and define your own laws, ranging from fair democracies to strict authoritarian dictatorships.

BUILD A LASTING LEGACY

In this single-shard MMO, everyone shares the same world. Seedlings have life cycles and eventually pass away, so your decisions carry long-term weight. The relationships, conflicts and history they build with one another leave a lasting mark on Avesta, shaping the course of humanity.

data.short_description: SEED is a 24/7 persistent society simulator MMO where your characters live, work, and die even while you’re offline. Collaborate with thousands of players in a single-shard world to build economies, interact with and manage your Seedlings, and shape the laws of a new planet.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5 / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU with at least 6 GB of VRAM and Direct 11 support (examples: NVIDIA GTX 1660, GTX 1060 6GB, or AMD RX 5600)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • VR Support: No
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i7 / AMD Ryzen 7
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU with 8 GB of VRAM and DirectX 12 support (examples: NVIDIA RTX 3060, AMD RX 6700 XT, or better)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • VR Support: No

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS Sonoma 14.0 or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 Pro
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS Sonoma 14.0 or later
  • Processor: Apple M2 Pro / M3 Pro or M1 Max
  • Memory: 24 MB RAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Suggestive Themes, Strong Language, and Use of Alcohol. General Mature Content.
